units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 1:6">Shek. I, 6</cite> <he>ואלו שחייבין בקו׳</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <he>בקל׳</he>) the following persons are bound to pay agio (on their half-Shekel). Ib. 7 <he>וכמה הוא ק׳ וכ׳</he> and how much is the agio? A M’ʿah silver. Y. ib. 46ᵇ <he>קוֹלְבָּנוֹ תורה</he> (Bab. ed. <he>קל׳</he>) the premium he has to pay is intimated in the Torah (<cite ref="Exodus 30:13">Ex. XXX, 13</cite>, because he has to pay the silver value of half a Shekel).
<cite ref="Exodus 30:13">Ib.</cite> bot.; Tosef. ib. I, 8; a. e.—

<cite ref="Bekhorot 50a:5">Bekh. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ לפרוטרוט</he> (not <he>קיל׳</he>) the dipondium is agio (an addition) to the units (making fifty, as a round sum, instead of forty-eight, v. Tosaf. a. l.).—Pl. <he>קוֹלְבּוֹנִין</he>, <he>קוֹלְבּוֹנוֹת</he>, <cite ref="S01246"><he>קָלְבּוֹ׳</he></cite>. Tosef. Shek. l. c. <he>חייב שני ק׳</he> is bound to pay double the agio. Ib. <he>וק׳ אלו מה עושין להם</he> and what is done with those agios? <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 1:6">Shek. I, 6</cite> <he>ק׳</he>, a. <cite ref="S00328"><he>קוֹלְבָּנ׳</he></cite> Y. ed. (Mish. ed. <he>קלבו׳</he>; Bab. ed. <he>קולבנ׳</he>).
